{{Quote|But you're a security officer!"''<br />''"Maybe so. But they don't pay me nearly enough for the risks I take down here everyday.|A Republic individual and Agent Folaris|<ref name="SWTORpartial" />}}
'''Tema Folaris''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She served as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] for the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]], working as an undercover [[Agent/Legends|agent]] in the [[Black Sun territory]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], Folaris discovered that the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate was planning to purge several members&mdash;[[Spy/Legends|informants]] and rival gang leaders&mdash;it suspected of undermining its operations. Folaris wanted access to that list so that the persons targeted could be warned. However, she also saw an opportunity in selling the list: if the names went public, the targeted persons would possibly be warned and Folaris would be able to supplement her income. A Republic individual whom Folaris had recruited to help her convinced her not to sell the list but turn it over to her superiors.

==Biography==
{{Quote|There's a rumor going around that Black Sun's about to clean house. Snitches, rival gang leaders&mdash;they're all gonna be dead meat. There's a list of these unfortunate individuals sitting on their computers. I need those names.|Agent Folaris|<ref name="SWTORpartial" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Folaris lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where she served as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Folaris was assigned as an undercover [[Agent/Legends|agent]] in the [[Black Sun territory]]. There, Folaris developed a list of contacts and [[Spy/Legends|informants]] to help her get information on the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate.<ref name="SWTORpartial" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="SWTORdate">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Folaris discovered that leaders in Black Sun were planning a purge of suspected spies and rival gang leaders. The mass [[Death/Legends|executions]] would cost Folaris her network of informants and the lives of innocent people. Folaris knew that she could [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] the [[Computer/Legends|computers]] of Black Sun and retrieve the list of targeted persons, but she needed to be able to prevent Black Sun from tracing her.<ref name="SWTORpartial" />

{{GameLSmechanics}}
She was able to convince a Republic individual to assist her by going inside the [[Black Sun Headquarters]] and disabling the tracing equipment. The individual did so and returned to Folaris, who had been able to retrieve the list. At that point, Folaris suggested to the individual that a good amount of money could be made from selling the list to an [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] named [[Nizkif]] at the [[Dealer's Den]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on Coruscant, where Folaris was well known. However, the individual convinced Folaris that selling the list would cause more harm than good, and she should turn the names over to her superiors.<ref name="SWTORpartial" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Let's just say I'm interested in what's best for the people of Coruscant.|Agent Folaris|<ref name="SWTORpartial" />}}
Folaris had light-[[Color/Legends|colored]] skin, blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and red [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. She served as an undercover police [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in one of the most dangerous areas of Coruscant with determination, if also frustration. Folaris felt that for the risks she was asked to take, she was not compensated financially enough to make the effort worth it. Though Folaris claimed loyalty to the [[Coruscanti/Legends|people]] of Coruscant, she also had a certain amount of personal greed. When the opportunity came to sell the list of Black Sun targets, Folaris jumped at the chance, despite her duty as a cop. However, Folaris was not so consumed by her resentment and greed that it took much convincing for her to abandon her scheme.<ref name="SWTORpartial" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Tema_Folaris_on_Port_Nowhere.jpg|thumb|Tema Folaris on Port Nowhere]]
Folaris appears in the mission "Partial Eclipse" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] by [[BioWare]] released in [[2011]]. The player can choose to alternatively agree to selling the list of names to Nizkif by meeting him in the Dealer's Den Cantina and thereby receive [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] points. The player can also choose to cheat Folaris out of the money.<ref name="SWTORpartial" />

She returns in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'' expansion, which also reveals her first name. During the [[raid on Port Nowhere]] she is taken hostage if the player's character is a Smuggler or Trooper. Overhearing the holocall from [[Jekiah Ordo]] mentioning that the Hidden Chain were targeting [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], she suggested the [[Alliance Commander]] seek out [[Jendan Blyes]] at [[Fort Garnik]]. For the characters of other classes, the same role is performed by [[Cedral Gend]], [[Thera Markon]] or [[Markan]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Chains in the Dark|[[Port Nowhere]]}}</ref>
